description: Static-check a host app entry against the es-plus preflight checklist (UI library, ESPlus plugin registration, httpRequest, permission, t, JSX transform). Pass the entry source and optionally the config the page was generated from (so only the capabilities that page actually needs are required) plus vite.config source (for UI auto-import / JSX plugin). Literal scan only: results are ok / missing / unverified — unverified means the item may be satisfied elsewhere and must be checked by hand.

config.description: Optional: the StructuredCrudConfig the page was generated from. When given, permission / t / httpRequest / JSX are required only if that config actually uses them.

entry.description: Source of the app entry, e.g. src/main.ts (or src/main.js for vue2).

target.description: Target framework the entry is for.

viteConfig.description: Optional: vite.config.* source. Needed to verify UI-library auto-import and the JSX plugin.

name: doctor_page
